purpose: Separate eligibility from ranking; measure lexical, native-dense and learned reranking on source-separated retrieval and novel-record use. Held-out groups are used once for final assessment.

training.objective: session.ranking_loss over eligible candidates; answer loss is never used for hard top-k
training.selection: all eligible records for each train query in deterministic case-id order
training.note: Train groups only; dev and held-out groups never enter the ranking update.

generation.prompt: Answer the query from stored records when a record answers it. Reply with only the value. If no stored record answers it, reply UNKNOWN.\n\nQuery: {query}

arms.description: eligible lexical retrieval, then record-order bank cap at 16 unit slots
native source-prefix mean-feature dense retrieval over eligible records, then bank cap
learned reranker over eligible lexical candidates, record score = max span score, then bank cap
only the expected eligible record is supplied; diagnostic for reader/answer errors, not a retrieval arm

scoring.retrieval: record recall@1 and recall@4, expected-record rank; numbers only for relevant cases and ranking arms
scoring.answer: decoded text stripped and casefolded; exact expected value; UNKNOWN is an abstention
scoring.correction: superseded record absent; corrected record selected if retrieved
scoring.long_record: selected span count and whether the fact token offset is inside the selected bank
scoring.distractors: count eligible non-expected records present in the neural bank
scoring.heldout: final assessment is held-out source groups only; train/dev remain development evidence

retention: Keep the parent E2 extension, the new reranker extension, the dataset, raw selected IDs/answers and every failure report. No base copy or download.
claims: Reranking remains opt-in unless held-out retrieval and answer results justify a default change. No generalization claim from exposed synthetic source groups.
